signals.title: Student visa processing-time variance for Iranian applicants
signals.summary_en: Student visa processing for Iranian applicants appears highly variable and difficult to predict.
signals.practical_impact: The available evidence supports high variance and uncertainty rather than a general visa freeze or universal long delay.
signals.who_should_care: Iranian applicants using an Australian study route and planning around visa-processing timelines.
signals.recommended_action: Plan for timeline variance and verify current official processing guidance before making fixed commitments.

official_verification.note: Candidate community signal migrated from the legacy dataset without adding an official claim.

conditional_adjustment.apply_when: Monitoring signal; no fit adjustment is applied from the legacy evidence alone.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: The evidence is mixed and was not independently re-verified during schema migration.

evidence.evidence_summary: An applicant reported approximately 100 days since lodgement with no update.
Another community member reported that their visa had recently been granted.
A community member stated that multiple applicants had received grants in under one month.

signals.title: Rapid Monash EOI academic pre-screening reports
signals.summary_en: Monash EOI screening may apply strict academic filters and can produce very rapid rejections.
signals.practical_impact: The reports are consistent with a fast pre-screen process, but they do not establish a universal GPA threshold across all Monash faculties or supervisors.
signals.who_should_care: Applicants to Monash University using an EOI or academic pre-screen step.
signals.recommended_action: Treat the reports as institution-specific planning context, not as a universal GPA rule.

official_verification.note: No current Monash policy was verified during schema migration.

conditional_adjustment.apply_when: Institution-specific monitoring signal; no fit adjustment from these reports alone.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: Legacy evidence suggests a pattern but does not establish a current universal threshold.

evidence.evidence_summary: An applicant with GPA 17.5/20 reported rejection within about 10 minutes and said follow-up indicated GPA was the reason.
Another applicant reported an EOI rejection approximately 20 minutes after submission.

signals.title: RMIT admission decision reportedly affected by visa feasibility
signals.summary_en: Visa feasibility may, in some cases, affect university admission decisions before the visa stage.
signals.practical_impact: This is a single self-report and should not be treated as a general RMIT admissions policy.
signals.who_should_care: Iran-origin master's applicants considering RMIT University.
signals.recommended_action: Do not generalize this single report; verify current RMIT admissions practice if it becomes decision-relevant.

official_verification.note: Single applicant report; no institutional policy verification was added during migration.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: Evidence rules require a single anecdote to remain non-penalizing.

evidence.evidence_summary: A master's applicant reported that RMIT told them the rejection was not due to GPA or CV but because they were unlikely to obtain a visa.

signals.title: Honours-equivalent qualification can constrain direct PhD entry

other_conditions: Direct PhD entry from a bachelor's degree

signals.summary_en: Direct PhD entry from an Iranian bachelor's degree may face structural difficulty where an Honours-equivalent qualification is expected.
signals.practical_impact: This is a community/adviser statement and not a verified rule applying identically to every Australian university or PhD program.
signals.who_should_care: Iran-educated bachelor's graduates considering direct PhD entry in Australia.
signals.recommended_action: Check the target university's current PhD entry and Honours-equivalency requirements directly.

official_verification.note: Legacy community guidance only; university-specific rules were not re-verified.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: The claim is broad and institution-specific verification is absent.

evidence.evidence_summary: A channel adviser stated that direct PhD exists but commonly requires a bachelor's Honours qualification and described this as difficult for applicants educated in Iran.

signals.title: Full master's funding appears profile-sensitive and high-friction
signals.summary_en: Full funding for master's study appears high-friction and strongly dependent on research profile and research-master eligibility.
signals.practical_impact: The source supports 'difficult and profile-sensitive', not 'impossible'.
signals.who_should_care: Applicants seeking fully funded master's study in Australia.
signals.recommended_action: Assess research-master eligibility and scholarship criteria separately rather than treating full funding as generally available or impossible.
signals.known_workaround: Research-oriented master's routes may be more relevant for applicants with a strong research profile.

official_verification.note: Two legacy statements appear to come from the same channel adviser and are kept as one independence group.

conditional_adjustment.apply_when: Monitoring signal; no fit adjustment from adviser guidance alone.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: The reports are not independent enough to justify a current penalty.

evidence.evidence_summary: A channel adviser stated that full funding at master's level is very difficult and requires a strong profile, with funding concentrated in research-oriented master's routes.
The same adviser suggested applicants with strong research experience try research master's programs, otherwise self-funded master's study may be the practical alternative.

signals.title: Incomplete admission documents may create material friction
signals.summary_en: Incomplete documentation may create significant friction because university admissions teams may provide limited flexibility when stated requirements are not met.
signals.practical_impact: This is operational community guidance rather than an official universal admissions rule.
signals.who_should_care: Applicants relying on flexibility around missing or incomplete university admission documents.
signals.recommended_action: Treat stated document requirements as binding unless the target institution confirms an exception in writing.

official_verification.note: Single adviser statement; no universal university policy was inferred.

conditional_adjustment.apply_when: Single community guidance statement; no fit adjustment.

signals.reason_for_adjustment: The evidence is insufficient for a generalized penalty.

evidence.evidence_summary: A channel adviser stated that Australian university admissions offices are not very accommodating when required documents are incomplete.
